title: Mission: To glorify God in all of life
summary: God made everything for his glory. Everything exists to show off what God is like, and as a reason for us to praise him. If everything exists for God’s glory, teaching any subject disconnected from God is treachery. God’s glory is not an “add on” to our mission statement, it’s the whole point. At Valor, we want our students to glorify God from the factory floor to the senate floor, from the board room to the living room.
